content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Nashik District Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Nashik District to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Nashik District for filling vacant positions under the state administration in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in the 2026 notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post name is Revenue Servant (Kotwal) across various Talukas and Sajas in the Nashik district.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed a minimum of 4th standard to be eligible for applying to the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as per the specified guidelines mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an honorarium/salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) posts.

faq.question: Q7. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 03-10-2026 and the last date to submit applications is 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for open category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for Open / General Category candidates is Rs. 600/-, while reserved category candidates pay Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Nashik District Kotwal recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written examination carrying 100 marks, followed by document verification and a medical examination.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online for this job notification?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can submit their applications online through the official portal at https://nashik.kotwal.org.
